integrity: The analytic all-order proof is supplied in RESULT.md; check_multiring.py provides only supplementary exact rational examples. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The degree condition is sufficient, not best possible. The theorem concerns equal-order concentric polygonal root rings with distinct positive real radii and isotropic Gaussian weight; no universal claim is made for arbitrary polynomial zeros or complex ring parameters.
title: Multiring polygonal Fock intensities: a sharp all-order peak bound
